plain_english_revision: The amendment adds two specific exemptions from property taxes (ad valorem taxation) in Alabama: (1) seed containers used for storing agricultural products and (2) grain bins. It also defines what qualifies as 'seed' under state law to clarify the exemption's scope.
candidate_position_supported: Advances targeted tax exemptions for agricultural infrastructure and seed storage, reducing property tax burdens on farmers and related businesses.
